message.reasoning_content: We need to classify relationship between two statements. In B, speaker is also chairing hearing, commenting on participation, mentioning mining issues, but not a clear stance on a specific proposition. However both are procedural, not taking stance on a specific proposition. The categories require "respond to the same specific proposition". They are different topics, so INCOMPARABLE if both have determinable positions. But do they have determinable positions? They express concern, but not a clear stance on a proposition. Might be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if at least one lacks determinable position. Both seem to be procedural opening remarks, not taking stance. So likely INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. But the definition: "pelo menos uma das manifestações não apresenta posição determinável sobre nenhuma proposição específica." Both lack specific proposition. So INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
